title: sdks: unify auth/retries/streaming ergonomics across python/ts/go and bump versions to v1.76.0
author: Asha Patel
description: Motivation: SDKs across Python/TypeScript/Go had drift in auth ergonomics, retry behavior, and streaming API shapes leading to operator confusion and parity bugs. This PR consolidates the cross-language behavior: standardized auth token refresh hooks, identical retry/backoff defaults (idempotency-aware), and a common streaming client shape (open/close/receive/send helpers + cancel semantics). Changes include API surface tweaks for ergonomics, internal refactors to share test vectors, and version bumps for each SDK.
commits_summary: 7 commits: initial TS ergonomic refactor; python auth token provider + tests; go streaming client and retry middleware; unify retry policy tests; bump package versions; update changelogs; CI fix for go module path.
files_changed: sdk/python/redwood/__init__.py, sdk/python/redwood/auth.py, sdk/python/tests/test_retries.py; sdk/typescript/src/client.ts, sdk/typescript/src/stream.ts, sdk/typescript/package.json; sdk/go/redwood/client.go, sdk/go/redwood/retries.go, sdk/go/redwood/stream_client.go; shared-tests/fixtures/retry_vector.json; templates/sdk-ergonomics.md; CHANGELOGs & package version files.
review_summary: Primary review by Daniel Kim (runtime) and Maria Gomez (dx). Major comments addressed: clarified token refresh error propagation (fixed in python/auth.py), added explicit Context/Cancel behavior to Go streaming client, and ensured TypeScript streaming exposes both async iterator and callback forms. One follow-up flagged to track in ENG-4903 (post-release linting). Approvals: Daniel Kim approved after 2 iterations; Maria Gomez approved; CI owner Ethan Zhou gave final thumbs up.
release_notes: SDKs: standardized auth token refresh hooks; unified retry/backoff defaults (idempotency-aware); improved streaming ergonomics (async iterator + callback + cancel semantics); Go/TS/Python parity fixes; bump versions to v1.76.0. See individual CHANGELOGs for migration notes.
